registry.native_counter_baseline: Raw native counters are baselined at every validated episode reset; ACS task counters must reset to zero. Deltas are differences of episode-relative cumulative values.

reward_reservation.purpose: reserved engine reward, intentionally zero; one shared reward computed centrally

specification.geometry_scope: Held-out corridor and arena lengths, gate locations, and pillar arrangements within the authored relay/two-console task topologies. Test geometry is not sampled from training templates. This is not arbitrary-map, new-topology, new-weapon, or new-enemy-class generalization.

split_manifest.nuisance_distribution: same versioned spawn/texture/enemy banks across geometry splits
split_manifest.scope: Held-out corridor and arena lengths, gate locations, and pillar arrangements within the authored relay/two-console task topologies. Test geometry is not sampled from training templates. This is not arbitrary-map, new-topology, new-weapon, or new-enemy-class generalization.

runtime.scope: observed_development_simulator_stack; not a CUDA/PyTorch training-host validation

selected_iwad.selection: explicit bundled freedoom2.wad; each worker verifies engine path and hash

renderer.native_barrier: both set_action then shared barrier then advance_action(1); four tics per logical decision
renderer.coordinated_reset: fresh participant processes and isolated episode working directories

license_provenance.original_vizdoom_code: MIT; bundled engine components retain their separate licenses
license_provenance.generated_pwads: Original project geometry and scripts; no copied IWAD sprites/textures in generated PWADs.
license_provenance.redistribution: Preserve upstream Freedoom credits/license when distributing the IWAD; do not label the entire engine bundle MIT.
